objective: Provide an integrated ordered/form-based GUI for creating, loading, validating, and saving canonical model_definition.json files and selecting them for the existing training workflow, so users no longer need to hand-edit model JSON.
completion_conditions: Each checkpoint durably records its pre-maker baseline, passes its fixed required-test allowlist, and receives a read-only checkpoint verifier PASS before the next checkpoint starts.

Users can create, load, inspect, reorder, edit, validate, and atomically save the existing canonical ModelSpec schema through deterministic Qt controls, including every currently registered layer type and structured non-nested branches, without hand-editing JSON or duplicating model rules.

MainWindow owns exactly one stable Model Designer tab whose explicit successful save/use path supplies TrainingPage's existing Model JSON input while preserving external JSON selection and every established training, inference, preview, cancellation, export, artifact, rerun, thread-cleanup, and close contract.

A bounded local-CPU qtbot graduation proves that a GUI-authored model passes existing validation/build APIs and completes the existing asynchronous training workflow on a tiny local dataset, with accurate workflow documentation and no fabricated evidence.

No change occurs outside the nine Phase files and no public model_definition, application, training, inference or artifact API/schema, dependency, launcher, graph/DAG editor, nested branch, model execution preview, CUDA/network feature, C++ GUI, packaging, installer, deployment migration, or Phase 15 work is introduced.

After all checkpoint verifiers pass, the Phase-wide read-only verifier evaluates the complete manifest-scoped delta and completion conditions; only its PASS permits the full project harness to run exactly once, and any mutation, ambiguous durable state, failure, or incomplete evidence fails closed without automatic Phase restart.
